payload.title: Implement account-bound publication and real receipts
payload.goal: A reviewed piece reaches the intended account once, with uncertainty handled before retry.
payload.owner_role: Windows combined release parent / admitted WHB lane
implementation_steps: Qualify current official Buffer API fields, scopes, exact organization/channel identity, account entitlement and zero-spend route; default to one reviewed X canary. Separate platform reply/interaction capability from original publication.

Create durable attempt and content/action key before send; paginate provider history to coverage bound or block ambiguity rather than trust first 100 rows/caption equality. Record provider accepted/scheduled/sending/sent/error plus public account/post/permalink/content readback.

Use stable action identity for retries, store returned receipt atomically, reconcile accepted-before-crash and public failure; supported correction/cancel/delete effects require distinct action grants and retained lineage.
tests: Timeout after accepted post is located in provider history and does not repost; old post beyond first page still deduplicates.
Buffer scheduled/dry-run ID does not pass public launch; actual account, content/hash and external permalink are verified.
Wrong account, unavailable media, route schema drift or invalid grant fails closed and preserves the candidate.

review.identity_requirement: A reviewer other than the implementer records actual identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model review when required by the admitted contract. Self-review does not qualify.
review.source_binding: Review exact Git commit and SHA256 manifest of changed source/assets/config; distinguish Windows CRLF worktree bytes from Git blobs. Any repair invalidates affected prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two repair/review attempts per candidate within admitted budget; unresolved failure creates one actionable block and leaves independent work eligible.

acceptance: One eligible real publication has both provider and correct-account destination receipts.
Absent external access yields a reviewed ready candidate and explicit gate, never a launch claim.
payload.rollback: Disable this capability, retain immutable evidence/receipts, restore the last reviewed source/config version and reconcile attempted external effects before any retry.
payload.next_eligible_action: Designated owner matches the proposed scope to current Jira/source and assigns disjoint paths; then perform implementation step 1. External gates block only the named effects.

estimate.assumptions: New planning estimate, not historical estimate or worklog. Reuse accepted returned implementation where its exact source passes this contract. Excludes elapsed observation windows, account waiting and shared SH implementation.
estimate.dependency_risk: Host/provider/account qualification or conflicting release-worker ownership can delay dependent effects; offline work remains eligible.
